mentions.name: Tandem reverse-trike halftrack
mentions.problem: Existing snowmobile ski-to-wheel conversions don't ride like a motorcycle and lack room for a passenger and cargo.
mentions.audience: A custom-built tandem reverse-trike halftrack combining the front end of an ATV with the rear track of a snowmobile. It rides like a motorcycle with extra length for a passenger and a cargo basket, styled to look like it came out of Mad Max. The builder plans to cruise around at festivals running an ad-hoc taxi service as a way of meeting people.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am building a tandem, reverse-trike halftrack, using the front end of an ATV and the back end of a snowmobile.

Replacing snowmobile skis with wheels is not a novel idea, but I wanted something which rides more like a motorcycle, with extra length for a passenger and a cargo basket.
